title: Google expands free AI tools beyond Chat GPT and competitors #GoogleAI #AITools
description:
Google launched more free AI tools than ChatGPT, Anthropic, and Perplexity combined, revealing a diverse suite for creators and developers. These include Nano Banana Pro for ultra-realistic image generation, Notebook LM for transforming documents into summaries and audio/visual content, and Opal, a no-code app builder that converts plain English descriptions into visual workflows.

Additional tools like Pomely generate brand-consistent social media content by analyzing website style, while Gemini Canvas transforms ideas into interactive apps and presentations. Stitch designs full app and website interfaces from simple prompts, and Google AI Studio’s Build feature enables app creation through plain-language descriptions powered by Gemini.

This expansive AI ecosystem highlights Google’s strategic focus on democratizing advanced AI capabilities, enabling businesses and individuals to enhance productivity, creativity, and digital presence without coding expertise.
